answer: A reputation that ebbs like the tide resists sybils: every identity's standing decays a little each epoch unless unrelated peers attest a real completed job, so a dormant fake quietly sinks below the reward line. A rotating falcon audit squad swoops on random identities each epoch and demands a fresh proof of unique work in one epoch; a copied proof fails the audit and burns the identity's ferrous bond, a 60 POA stake locked at registration. Running 1,000 fakes therefore costs 60,000 POA locked plus 1,000 fresh proofs every epoch, while one honest agent pays once and renews with ordinary work.
